gloss: travel stories; tales from a trip

definitions.gloss: travel stories; tales from a trip
definitions.explanation: Stories and anecdotes that someone brings back from a journey to share with others. The word treats these stories as a kind of intangible souvenir.

examples.japanese: {土産話|みやげばなし}を{聞|き}かせて。
{旅行|りょこう}の{土産話|みやげばなし}で{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: We had a great time sharing travel stories.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}から{帰|かえ}ってきた{友人|ゆうじん}が、{面白|おもしろ}い{土産話|みやげばなし}をたくさん{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}った。
examples.english: My friend who returned from overseas brought back many interesting travel stories.

notes:
Composed of {土産|みやげ} (souvenir) and {話|ばなし} (story, talk). The rendaku (sequential voicing) changes はなし to ばなし. The word treats stories and experiences from a trip as something you "bring back" to share, like a souvenir.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土産話|みやげばなし}を{聞|き}かせる: to share travel stories (with someone)
- {土産話|みやげばなし}で{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる: to get excited sharing travel stories
- {土産話|みやげばなし}に{花|はな}が{咲|さ}く: to chat animatedly about a trip

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {旅行記|りょこうき}: travel journal, travelogue — a written account, more formal and structured
- {体験談|たいけんだん}: account of personal experience — broader term, not limited to travel
